fusions.name: Broad-Backed Shove
fusions.desc: A long push with the flat of the blade that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and throws the target back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Grazed Seabed
fusions.desc: Stirs up the silt around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each [Stalled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Wallow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tomorrow Will Do
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
